description: Quwi's Chess Patches 1.16.6-dev: Game Review on your computer works on chess.com 4.10.31 again. That build added two flags to the game analysis permissions, so the local review failed with "couldn't review your game" right after the engine finished; the permissions are now built from whichever all-capabilities constructor the installed build has. The App logs file also keeps only the useful lines now.
